parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

*   If you set **InstanceType** to **VBR**, specify a VBR ID.
*   If you set **InstanceType** to **VPC**, specify a VPC ID.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of instance. Valid values:

*   **VBR**: queries the permissions that are granted to a VBR.
*   **VPC**: queries the permissions that are granted from a VPC.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: VbrRegionNo
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the instance is deployed.

*   If **InstanceType** is set to **VBR**, this parameter is required.
*   If **InstanceType** is set to **VPC**, you can ignore this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-ec-grant-relation --instance-type VBR --instance-id vbr-bp12mw1f8k3jgygk90000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vbr-region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
